registered_extensions.meaning: Written identity and syntax of a native annotation; no fabricated managed attribute class.
registered_extensions.multiplicity: Exactly one extension per accepted native annotation application; zero for other languages.
registered_extensions.ordering: Properties are named scalars; annotation_argument.ordinal preserves argument order separately.
registered_extensions.evidence: Compiler attribute kind/name plus exact annotation.span_id and captured bytes; unsupported syntax retains source and explicit coverage.
registered_extensions.missing_states: A supported accepted native application requires every property. Null namespace means syntactically unqualified, not unknown; an unsupported or unavailable spelling cannot be replaced by an empty string.

properties.name: written_name
properties.meaning: Unqualified attribute name as written, such as deprecated; do not infer a managed type name.

properties.name: namespace
properties.meaning: Written attribute namespace; null is syntactically unqualified and has explicit inapplicability meaning within this registered payload.

registered_extensions.language: language-independent; compiler-specific primitive keys are tagged
registered_extensions.meaning: Minimal typed preimage that permits canonical ID validation without depending on allocation order or recursively hashing the record output.
registered_extensions.multiplicity: Exactly one for each canonical registry record; omitted for profile-only minimal anchors.
registered_extensions.ordering: Named properties use canonical UTF-8 key ordering. Ordered component arrays preserve the exact registered recipe order.
registered_extensions.evidence: Validated capture/context descriptors and compiler-key evidence; recomputation proves identity consistency, not extraction semantics.
registered_extensions.missing_states: All envelope properties and registered required components are known. Nullable component states are explicitly defined by their selected domain schema; absent or unregistered preimages prevent canonical finalization.

normalization_boundary.rule: The envelope supplements typed payload; finalization compares components with capture/context/typed fields and recomputes the canonical ID. It never replaces source/semantic facts.

properties.name: domain
properties.meaning: Versioned identity-family recipe discriminator; only registered domains are accepted.

properties.name: components
properties.meaning: One typed components object selected by domain, with no extra fields; arrays and references retain the exact recipe semantics.
properties.units: Per selected component schema: byte offsets/counts are original bytes; ordinals are zero-based; hashes are SHA-256; IDs are typed references.
